decisions.statement: A read answers with the whole body rather than with the keys a page declares.
A read names the commit its bodies were read at.
A read naming a commit is answered at that commit.
A read naming no commit is answered at the commit HEAD is on.
A read naming a commit the repository does not hold is refused.
A page is placed by the index now rather than by the commit a read names.
Every body a read answers with is read at that read's commit.
A body is read out of the commit rather than off the working tree.
A property held outside the commit has no commit to be read out of.
Such a property is read off the checkout the read was handed.
Such a property is read as it is now whatever commit a read names.
A path standing outside `akasha` is refused before anything is read.
A path with a page's secret values is refused before anything is read.
A path with a page's uncommitted values is refused before anything is read.
A path a page is placed at is withheld by the same rule.
One withheld path refuses the whole read.
A withheld path is refused rather than answered as nothing.
A page is named by its page type and its slug.
A page named that way is placed by the index.
A page the index places nowhere is said to be unplaced.
A page the index places at more than one path refuses the read.
A path the commit does not have answers as nothing rather than as empty text.
The bodies of a read come back through one git process.
A read that throws is answered as a refusal rather than thrown on.
Nothing here writes.
A read takes no hold.
A body that is not text reads as the replacement character.

definition: the whole body standing at a path, and the commit it was read at
